about_the_game:
High speed & hard crash & eye-rolling Visual Bliss Violence at its finest here!

The first installment of the new indie game Lebevel weaves together is now available!

Destroy everything in sight!

The first in a series of new indie game levees!

  • Constant Motion: Your character is always moving! Control momentum and speed as you smash through everything in your path.

  • Simple Controls: Navigate using the mouse, and perform a charged dash with the spacebar to surge forward and destroy even more.

  • Time-Limited Challenge: How much damage can you cause within the time limit? Quick thinking and fast reactions are key.

  • Target Score: Each stage has a set damage goal—can you reach it?

  • Random Events: Random events and challenges may appear during gameplay. Participation is optional, but successfully completing them can earn extra points.

  • Stages: There are 4 stages in total, each filled with destructible objects so you can enjoy a variety of destruction.

Smash through the city, rack up damage, and gradually spiral into ruin—an action game that explores the stages of life.

Video Streaming Guidelines

  • Both individuals and organizations are permitted to upload and stream videos, regardless of monetization.

  • We assume no responsibility for any damages arising from the uploading or streaming of such videos.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains mild cartoon violence and humor, including scenes where characters are launched through the air and fictional tombstones are destroyed.

It also includes suggestive items that may imply substance use, though no specific substances are named. These items can cause characters to behave erratically or move faster.
